title: SpecRunnerJsonResult
description: Output of `spec-runner run --json-result`. Single task emits one object; multiple tasks emit an array of objects. See docs/state-schema.md.

cost_usd.description: Sum of attempt cost, rounded to 2 decimals

duration_seconds.description: Sum of attempt duration, rounded to 1 decimal

review.description: Review verdict on the last attempt

error.description: Truncated error message (only present on failure)

no_op.description: Present (and true) when the task completed without any committable changes — its work was already absorbed by earlier tasks (v2.16.0, #97)

verify_outcome.description: Present only when the task recorded live verify-first evidence (execution_mode: verify_first, #367). The outcome of that run, independent of the task's TDD/standard completion path

verify_composition.description: Present only when the recorded verify-first evidence carries a file-target composition (verify-first-file-scope-group-targets workstream, FR-21/FR-22). A green run whose composition has skipped >= 1 is distinguishable from one where every member executed without comparing compositions by hand.

size.description: Total number of composition members the collection phase reported.

executed.description: Members whose outcome was passed/failed/error (actually ran).

skipped.description: Members accounted for but never executed (skipped/xfail/deselected).

EmptyResult.title: EmptyResult
EmptyResult.description: Emitted when no tasks were ready to run.
